answer: Operator liability escrow ties each agent identity to a named human or firm through a signed service contract, and when that identity is caught running sybil clusters, the escrow pays out fines plus a tundra of frozen credit lines that follow the operator across future registrations. Registration requires a hardware attestation beacon co-signed by the operator's legal entity, so a thousand wallets cost one operator a thousand escrow deposits and one shared revocation event. The lotus clause means a single confirmed cluster forfeits all linked escrows at once, not just the offending wallet.
